question: The perpendicular distance between the centre of a circle and the longest chord of that circle is _______.
solution:
**Given:**

The figure for which the distance is to be calculated is circle.

**Concept Used:**

The longest chord of circle is diameter.

**Explanation:**

Let us take a circle with AB as diameter and O as its center.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9adf40e7ef4f93dbe08e6ab882473dd65f9e4987631c672feb603b9b20e5c462.png] 

 

 

 

 

 

 

Here, AB is the longest chord. This can also be understood by drawing multiples chords, everytime diamter will come out to be the longest chord.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5147ca3077adc58a6b1b96993b61665486ba766d423f4f0d4ed19c85b3728f36.png] 

Now, as the diameter is the longest chord and it passes through center. So, perpendicular distance between center and longest chord will be 0.

 ∴ **The perpendicular distance between the center of a circle and the longest chord of that circle is 0.**
